task: Pick up the CUP and place it on the TABLE.
plan_summary: Navigate to the cup, pick it up, navigate to the table, and place the cup on the table.
assumptions: The robot's interaction distance is sufficient to pick up the cup and place it on the table.
The robot starts not holding any object.
The cup is graspable and within interaction distance after navigating to its location.
The table is reachable and the robot can place the cup on it after navigating to its location.
